Sam P: hey team, Sam here — first day on CS, quick: who do I ping to get HubSpot + Aircall access and the CS playbook link?
Mike (IT): welcome Sam! @Sam P I requested HubSpot invite and an Aircall seat. You should get emails in ~15min. If not, say so and Ill escalate.
Liz C: hi Sam :wave: playbooks live in the shared drive under /playbooks/cs. I'll add you to the CS folder. Also check the 'First Week CS Cadence' doc.
Jamie R: Sam - I run the 1:1 playbook walk. Ping me after youre in HubSpot and well book 30m.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: complete "Sales/CS Tools" checklist: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-cs within 48h.
Sam P: got the HubSpot invite and MFA set. Aircall pending but saw the request. thanks all!
Mike (IT): Aircall invite sent again, should arrive now. Lmk if it lands in spam.
Sam P: received Aircall and headset set. one more Q: where's the objection cheat sheet? couldn't find by name.
Jamie R: file is "OBJECTION_MAP_v2 - CS" in /playbooks/cs/cheatsheets. DMing link.
Liz C: also recommended: listen to two calls in call-library (onboarding + escalation). Ill flag examples in the folder.
Sam P: perfect, thanks everyone :tada:
